title: David Deutsch on Optimism
summary: An excerpt from an RSA event in which physicist David Deutsch makes the case for optimism as a driver of progress in the 21st century. It is a short highlight of a longer discussion.
why: Pointed to as an antidote to pessimism about the future, tied to Deutsch's ideas in The Beginning of Infinity.

quote.text: I encourage everyone pessimistic about our future to learn about David Deutsch's infinite optimism
